<?php
// Read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$A = intval($line);

// Function to get all divisors of n
function get_divisors($n) {
    $divs = [];
    $limit = (int)sqrt($n);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($n % $i == 0) {
            $divs[] = $i;
            if ($i != $n / $i) {
                $divs[] = (int)($n / $i);
            }
        }
    }
    sort($divs);
    return $divs;
}

$divs = get_divisors($A);
$count = 0;

foreach ($divs as $d) {
    // d is a divisor of A, so candidate x = d - 1
    if ($d <= 1) continue; // x must be positive, so d >= 2
    $x = $d - 1;
    // Check if sum of divisors of x equals A
    $sum = 0;
    $limit = (int)sqrt($x);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($x % $i == 0) {
            $sum += $i;
            $j = (int)($x / $i);
            if ($j != $i) $sum += $j;
            if ($sum > $A) break; // early stop
        }
    }
    if ($sum == $A) $count++;
}

echo $count . PHP_EOL;
?>

// Read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
if ($line === '') {
    exit;
}
$A = intval($line);

// If A is odd, no solutions (since J(x) is even for all x)
if ($A % 2 == 1) {
    echo "0\n";
    exit;
}

$half = intdiv($A, 2);
$count = 0;

// Enumerate all divisors d of A/2
$limit = (int)sqrt($half);
for ($d = 1; $d <= $limit; $d++) {
    if ($half % $d == 0) {
        // First divisor d
        if (gcd($d, $half / $d) == 1) {
            $count++;
        }
        $d2 = intdiv($half, $d);
        if ($d2 != $d) {
            // Second divisor A/2 / d
            if (gcd($d2, $half / $d2) == 1) {
                $count++;
            }
        }
    }
}

echo $count . "\n";

function gcd($a, $b) {
    while ($b != 0) {
        $t = $a % $b;
        $a = $b;
        $b = $t;
    }
    return $a;
}
?>

// Function to compute sum of divisors
function sum_of_divisors($n) {
    $sum = 0;
    $limit = intval(sqrt($n));
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        if ($n % $i == 0) {
            $sum += $i;
            $d = intdiv($n, $i);
            if ($d != $i) $sum += $d;
        }
    }
    return $sum;
}

$count = 0;

// Iterate over divisors d of A
$limit = intval(sqrt($A));
for ($d = 1; $d <= $limit; $d++) {
    if ($A % $d != 0) continue;
    $k = intdiv($A, $d); // k = A / d

    // x = k - 1 must be positive
    if ($k > 1) {
        $x = $k - 1;
        if (sum_of_divisors($x) == $A) $count++;
    }

    // Check the paired divisor if different
    $d2 = intdiv($A, $d);
    if ($d2 != $d) {
        $k = intdiv($A, $d2);
        if ($k > 1) {
            $x = $k - 1;
            if (sum_of_divisors($x) == $A) $count++;
        }
    }
}

echo $count . PHP_EOL;
?>
